h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Naihati

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Naihati

c: Naihati grew up around the jute mills on the east bank of the Hooghly, and it is still an important railway junction in North 24 Parganas. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Naihati for the municipality, schools, colleges, clubs and the old mill colonies. We manufacture every machine at our Vasai factory, about 1650 km away, and send it to Bengal by road.

A dealer from our eastern India network or our own installation team fixes the machines on arrival. The Hooghly belt is humid all year, with a long monsoon and occasional waterlogging. Galvanised frames resist rust, and a raised concrete base keeps the footings dry. Many sites here are old club grounds or colony parks, where a small set of well-placed machines works better than a big frame.

items.q: Can a club in Naihati buy a small outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. Many clubs start with three machines near the entrance. Share the ground size and photos, and we will suggest a set and send a layout with a quote.

items.q: How do we deal with damp and waterlogging?
items.a: Use a raised concrete base with a slight slope, clear standing water after rain and check the bolts and moving parts once the monsoon ends.

items.q: What warranty applies in West Bengal?
items.a: The same as everywhere: three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, for manufacturing defects.
